items.stem: Read the notice and answer the question. NOTICE. The school library will be closed from May 1 to May 3 for repairs. Books borrowed before April 28 can be kept until May 10. The reading room on the second floor will reopen on May 4. Students who need a quiet place to study may use Room 305 in the teaching building during these days. We are sorry for any trouble. Question: Why will the library be closed?
items.analysis: 首句 will be closed from May 1 to May 3 for repairs 直接说明闭馆原因是维修（repairs）。holiday、meeting、move 均为无关干扰项，文中没有依据。

items.stem: Read the notice and fill in the blank with one word. NOTICE. The school library will be closed from May 1 to May 3 for repairs. Books borrowed before April 28 can be kept until May 10. The reading room on the second floor will reopen on May 4. Students who need a quiet place to study may use Room 305 in the teaching building during these days. We are sorry for any trouble. In the last sentence, the word trouble can best be replaced by ___.
items.analysis: We are sorry for any trouble 是通知中的致歉套语，trouble 指闭馆给读者带来的“不便”，故用 inconvenience 替换最贴切。填 problem、difficulty 语义偏重，且 inconvenience 才是该类通知的固定表达。

items.stem: Translate the following sentence from the notice into Chinese: Students who need a quiet place to study may use Room 305 in the teaching building during these days.
items.answer: 参考译文：这些天需要安静地方学习的学生，可以使用教学楼 305 室。
items.analysis: 翻译要点有三：who need a quiet place to study 是定语从句，前置译为“……的学生”；may use 译为“可以使用”，保留许可语气；during these days 译为“这些天/在此期间”。in the teaching building 是地点状语，置于“305 室”之前更符合汉语顺序。

items.stem: Read the passage and answer the question. Scientists have found that the blue light from phone screens can delay sleep. When we look at a bright screen at night, our brain thinks it is still daytime and produces less of the hormone that makes us sleepy. As a result, we may lie awake for a long time after putting the phone down. In one study, people who read on a screen before bed took about ten minutes longer to fall asleep than those who read a printed book. Researchers suggest keeping phones out of the bedroom or using a warmer, dimmer light in the evening. They also remind us that a regular bedtime matters as much as the light itself. Question: What can the blue light from phone screens do, according to the passage?
options: It can make us fall asleep faster.
items.analysis: 首句 the blue light from phone screens can delay sleep 直接给出答案，delay 意为“推迟、使延迟”。A 与原文相反；C、D 文中完全没有提到。

items.stem: Read the passage and answer the question. When Mei was twelve, her family moved to a small town, and she could hardly speak the local dialect. On her first day at the new school, she sat alone at lunch, staring at her rice bowl. An old teacher, Mrs. Chen, put a plate of dumplings beside her and said, Taste mine. My mother made them. They were not delicious, but Mei ate three. Every day that week, Mrs. Chen found a small excuse to talk to her. Twenty years later, Mei became a teacher herself. On the first day of each term, she always brings extra food to school, looking for the child who sits alone. Question: Why did Mei sit alone at lunch on her first day?
options: Because she had no money for lunch.
Because she was ill that day.
Because she could hardly speak the local dialect.
items.analysis: 首句说 her family moved to a small town, and she could hardly speak the local dialect，语言不通使她难以与同学交流，于是独自坐着。A、C、D 文中都没有依据，C 更与后文她吃了三个饺子矛盾。

items.stem: Read the passage and answer the question. In many Western classrooms, students are encouraged to ask questions and even to disagree with the teacher. In many Asian classrooms, by contrast, listening quietly and respecting the teacher are seen as signs of a good student. Neither style is simply better. A Chinese student in London may find seminars difficult at first because she waits to be invited to speak, while her British classmates think she has nothing to say. Teachers who understand both cultures often give such students a few minutes to prepare their ideas in writing before the discussion. Understanding the difference does not mean giving up one's own way of learning; it means knowing when to adjust. Question: What are students in many Western classrooms encouraged to do?
options: To ask questions and even disagree with the teacher.
items.analysis: 首句 are encouraged to ask questions and even to disagree with the teacher 直接给出答案。A 恰是文中描述的另一种课堂风格；C、D 文中未提。

items.stem: Read the passage and choose the best word for blank (1). Last winter, Tom's grandfather gave him an old bicycle. It was rusty and the tyres were flat, but Tom was (1)___. He spent every evening in the garage, cleaning the chain and (2)___ the tyres. His friends laughed at him, saying the bike was too old to ride. Tom (3)___, however. After three weeks, the bicycle looked almost new. On the first warm Sunday, he rode it to the top of the hill and (4)___ down with the wind in his face. His grandfather, watching from the door, (5)___. Later Tom understood that the old man had not given him a bicycle but a lesson: things are worth keeping if you are willing to work on them.
items.analysis: 自行车虽旧，但后文写他每天傍晚都在车库擦链条、修轮胎，说明他很高兴，故填 delighted。angry、frightened 与情节相反；bored 无法解释他主动花时间修车的行为。

After three weeks, the bicycle looked almost new. On the first warm Sunday, he rode it to the top of the hill and (4)___ down with the wind in his face. His grandfather, watching from the door, (5)___. Later Tom understood that the old man had not given him a bicycle but a lesson: things are worth keeping if you are willing to work on them.
items.analysis: however 表转折，说明朋友嘲笑他“车太旧不能骑”，他却没有放弃，kept on（继续坚持）与后文“三周后车子焕然一新”一致。gave up 与转折和结果都矛盾；went out、sat down 与“坚持修车”无关。

items.stem: Read the passage and choose the best word for blank (4). Last winter, Tom's grandfather gave him an old bicycle. It was rusty and the tyres were flat, but Tom was (1)___. He spent every evening in the garage, cleaning the chain and (2)___ the tyres. His friends laughed at him, saying the bike was too old to ride. Tom (3)___, however. After three weeks, the bicycle looked almost new. On the first warm Sunday, he rode it to the top of the hill and (4)___ down with the wind in his face. His grandfather, watching from the door, (5)___. Later Tom understood that the old man had not given him a bicycle but a lesson: things are worth keeping if you are willing to work on them.
items.analysis: 空格前是 rode it to the top of the hill，空格后是 down with the wind in his face（风扑面而来），说明他顺坡飞驰而下，raced down 最贴切。walked 与 rode 冲突；climbed 方向相反；looked down 无“风扑面”的速度感。

items.stem: Read the passage and choose the best word for blank (5). Last winter, Tom's grandfather gave him an old bicycle. It was rusty and the tyres were flat, but Tom was (1)___. He spent every evening in the garage, cleaning the chain and (2)___ the tyres. His friends laughed at him, saying the bike was too old to ride. Tom (3)___, however. After three weeks, the bicycle looked almost new. On the first warm Sunday, he rode it to the top of the hill and (4)___ down with the wind in his face. His grandfather, watching from the door, (5)___. Later Tom understood that the old man had not given him a bicycle but a lesson: things are worth keeping if you are willing to work on them.
items.analysis: 爷爷 watching from the door 看孙子骑车下山，心里欣慰，故 smiled。文中气氛温暖，无冲突，shouted 不合语境；left、slept 与“看着”这一动作矛盾。

items.stem: Read the last sentence of the passage and fill in the blank with one word: things are worth ___ if you are willing to work on them. (The story is about Tom and his old bicycle.)
items.analysis: be worth doing sth. 是固定搭配，worth 后接动名词，且 things 与 keep 是被动关系但形式仍用主动的 -ing，故填 keeping。不能填 to keep（worth 后不接不定式）或 kept。

items.stem: Read the passage and answer in no more than 20 words. Last winter, Tom's grandfather gave him an old bicycle. It was rusty and the tyres were flat, but Tom was (1)___. He spent every evening in the garage, cleaning the chain and (2)___ the tyres. His friends laughed at him, saying the bike was too old to ride. Tom (3)___, however. After three weeks, the bicycle looked almost new. On the first warm Sunday, he rode it to the top of the hill and (4)___ down with the wind in his face. His grandfather, watching from the door, (5)___. Later Tom understood that the old man had not given him a bicycle but a lesson: things are worth keeping if you are willing to work on them. Question: What lesson did Tom learn from the old bicycle?
items.answer: Things are worth keeping if you are willing to work on them.
items.analysis: 答案即全文末句的点睛之笔：旧车之所以值得保留，是因为人肯为它付出劳动。作答需概括出“肯花功夫，东西（或事情）就值得珍惜”的意思，只写 the bike was old 不得分。

items.stem: Read the passage and choose the best word for blank (1). Honey has been used as food for thousands of years. What makes it special is that it almost never (1)___. Ordinary food goes bad because bacteria grow in it, but honey contains very little water, and bacteria cannot (2)___ in such a dry environment. Honey is also very (3)___, so there is hardly any water for bacteria to use. When honey is kept in a (4)___ jar, it can stay good for years. Archaeologists have even found pots of honey in ancient tombs that were still (5)___ after more than 2,000 years.
items.analysis: 后文反复讲食物因细菌繁殖而变质、蜂蜜却多年不坏，说明蜂蜜“几乎从不腐坏”，spoils（变质）最合逻辑。sells 与“保持食物品质”无关；melts、freezes 是物理变化，不能解释后文的防菌原理。

items.stem: Read the passage and choose the best word for blank (2). Honey has been used as food for thousands of years. What makes it special is that it almost never (1)___. Ordinary food goes bad because bacteria grow in it, but honey contains very little water, and bacteria cannot (2)___ in such a dry environment. Honey is also very (3)___, so there is hardly any water for bacteria to use. When honey is kept in a (4)___ jar, it can stay good for years. Archaeologists have even found pots of honey in ancient tombs that were still (5)___ after more than 2,000 years.
items.analysis: 细菌在干燥环境中无法生存繁殖，live 最准确，且与前文 bacteria grow 呼应。fly 只适用于会飞的生物；hide、sleep 与“干燥环境使其无法存活”的科学解释不符。

items.stem: Read the passage and choose the best word for blank (3). Honey has been used as food for thousands of years. What makes it special is that it almost never (1)___. Ordinary food goes bad because bacteria grow in it, but honey contains very little water, and bacteria cannot (2)___ in such a dry environment. Honey is also very (3)___, so there is hardly any water for bacteria to use. When honey is kept in a (4)___ jar, it can stay good for years. Archaeologists have even found pots of honey in ancient tombs that were still (5)___ after more than 2,000 years.
items.analysis: 空格后 so there is hardly any water for bacteria to use 是结果，说明蜂蜜质地浓稠、含水量极低，thick（浓稠的）与这一解释一致。thin 恰好相反；cold、soft 都不能推出“几乎没有水可用”。

items.stem: Read the passage and choose the best word for blank (4). Honey has been used as food for thousands of years. What makes it special is that it almost never (1)___. Ordinary food goes bad because bacteria grow in it, but honey contains very little water, and bacteria cannot (2)___ in such a dry environment. Honey is also very (3)___, so there is hardly any water for bacteria to use. When honey is kept in a (4)___ jar, it can stay good for years. Archaeologists have even found pots of honey in ancient tombs that were still (5)___ after more than 2,000 years.
items.analysis: 蜂蜜能多年不坏的条件是装进密封的罐子，sealed（密封的）与 stay good for years 构成条件关系。broken 会进空气和水分，反而变质；wet 与干燥防菌的原理矛盾；paper 与罐子材质搭配不当。

items.stem: Read the passage and choose the best word for blank (5). Honey has been used as food for thousands of years. What makes it special is that it almost never (1)___. Ordinary food goes bad because bacteria grow in it, but honey contains very little water, and bacteria cannot (2)___ in such a dry environment. Honey is also very (3)___, so there is hardly any water for bacteria to use. When honey is kept in a (4)___ jar, it can stay good for years. Archaeologists have even found pots of honey in ancient tombs that were still (5)___ after more than 2,000 years.
items.analysis: 考古学家在古墓中发现两千多年前的蜂蜜“仍然可以食用”，still good 是英语中表示食物未变质的常用说法。empty 与“考古发现”的惊讶语气不符；black、lost 与上下文无关。

items.stem: Complete the sentence with the correct form of the word in brackets: Honey contains very little water, ___ (make) it hard for bacteria to grow.
items.analysis: 前后两部分是因果关系，后半部分作结果状语且逻辑主语就是前面整件事，用现在分词 making 表自然结果。不能填 made（过去分词表被动，此处无被动关系）或 to make（不定式不作结果状语）。

items.stem: Translate the following sentence into Chinese: Honey contains very little water, and bacteria cannot live in such a dry environment.
items.answer: 参考译文：蜂蜜含水量很低，细菌无法在这样干燥的环境中生存。
items.analysis: 翻译要点：contains very little water 译为“含水量很低”比“包含很少的水”更地道；such a dry environment 译“这样干燥的环境”；and 连接两个并列分句，汉语可保留逗号顺承，无须译出“并且”。

items.stem: Choose the best phrasal verb: Don't ___ hope; the exam is still two months away.
items.analysis: give up hope 是固定搭配，意为“放弃希望”。give away 意为“赠送、泄露”；give out 意为“分发、耗尽”；give in 意为“屈服、让步”，均不能与 hope 搭配表示“放弃”。

items.stem: Choose the best phrasal verb: It's cold outside. ___ your coat before you leave.
items.analysis: 天冷出门要“穿上”外套，put on 正合语境。take off 是“脱下、起飞”，方向相反；take up 意为“开始从事、占据”；put down 意为“放下、写下”。

items.stem: Choose the best phrasal verb: The meeting was ___ because the manager was ill.
items.analysis: 经理生病，会议只能“推迟”，put off 意为“推迟、拖延”。put on 是“穿上、上演”；put up 是“搭建、张贴”；put out 是“扑灭”。

items.stem: Choose the best phrasal verb: I can't ___ the noise any longer.
items.analysis: put up with 意为“忍受”，后接 the noise，与 can't ... any longer 搭配表示“再也受不了这噪音”。put up 单独使用是“搭建、张贴”，不表示忍受；put off 是“推迟”；put away 是“收好”。

items.stem: Choose the best phrasal verb: She ___ her mother; they both have the same smile.
items.analysis: 两人笑容一样，说明她“长得像”母亲，take after 意为“（在外貌或性格上）像”。take off 是“脱下、起飞”；take over 是“接管”；take in 是“吸收、理解、欺骗”。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: Though the plan sounded attractive, it ___ (turn out) to be a failure in the end.
items.analysis: 表示“结果发现、原来是”用 turn out，此处叙述过去的事，故用过去式 turned out；turn out to be 是常见结构。不能填 turned up（出现、调高）或 turned into（变成，后不接 to be）。

items.stem: Translate the sentence into English with the phrasal verb look forward to: 我们期待不久见到你。
items.answer: We look forward to seeing you soon.
items.analysis: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后接动名词 seeing，不能接 see；主语为 we，用一般现在时表期待。评分看三点：look forward to 拼写完整、to 后接 -ing、句意含 soon。

items.stem: Choose the best response: - Thank you very much for your help. - ___
items.analysis: 对感谢的应答用 You're welcome（不用谢）。Never mind 用于回应道歉或安慰对方“没关系、别在意”；That's right 表示“说得对”；No, thanks 用于婉拒别人的提议。

items.stem: Choose the best response: - I'm sorry I'm late. - ___
items.analysis: 对道歉的应答用 That's all right（没关系）。You're welcome 只用于回应感谢；Thank you 用于道谢；Yes, please 用于接受别人的提议，三者都与道歉场景不匹配。

items.stem: Choose the best response: - Sorry, I broke your cup. - ___
items.analysis: 对方为损坏物品道歉，应答“没关系”用 It doesn't matter。Not at all 一般用于回应感谢（“不客气”）或回答 Do you mind（“一点也不”）；That's right 表示认同对方的说法；I'm afraid not 表示委婉否定。

items.stem: Choose the best response: - Thanks a lot for the ride. - ___
items.analysis: Don't mention it 意为“别客气”，是对感谢的常见应答。Never mind 回应道歉；Of course not 回答请求或 Do you mind 的问句；I'm sorry 用于道歉，与对方道谢的语境不符。

items.stem: Choose the best response: - I do apologize for the delay. - ___
items.analysis: I do apologize 是较正式的道歉，应答用 That's quite all right（完全没关系），语气与正式程度相称。You're welcome 回应感谢；Yes, I do 是对 Do you ...? 的回答；Take it easy 用于劝人放松或道别。

items.stem: Complete the response with one proper sentence (accept the apology and show understanding): - I'm terribly sorry I forgot your birthday. - ___
items.answer: Don't worry about it. I know how busy you have been.
items.analysis: 应答需同时做到两点：接受道歉（Don't worry about it / That's OK / Never mind）并表达理解（I know how busy you are），才能既礼貌又真诚。只写 Never mind 失之于冷淡，回答 That's your fault 则完全失礼。

items.stem: A friend says to you: Thank you for looking after my dog while I was away. Write one suitable reply in English (no more than 10 words).
items.answer: My pleasure. It was no trouble at all.
items.analysis: 对感谢的应答要简短、自然、得体，常用 My pleasure、It was no trouble at all、You're welcome、Glad I could help 等；不要用 Never mind（用于道歉）或 OK（过于随意）。评分看是否切合感谢场景、是否控制在 10 词内。

items.stem: Choose the best response: - Would you like to come to my birthday party? - ___
items.analysis: 接受邀请常用 I'd love to（我很乐意），后加 thanks 更礼貌。B 中 would like 后缺宾语 to (come)；C 直接拒绝，既生硬又不符合 would like 的问句形式；D 用于回应道歉或感谢。

items.stem: Choose the best response: - Why don't we go for a walk? - ___
items.analysis: Why don't we ...? 是提出建议的句型，赞同建议用 Good idea（好主意）。Thank you 用于感谢；I'm sorry to hear that 用于表示同情；Never mind 用于安慰或回应道歉。

items.stem: Choose the best response: - You'd better see a doctor. - ___
options: That's very kind of you to say so.
items.analysis: 对方给出建议（最好去看医生），接受建议用 Yes, I think I will（我想我会的）。B 前后矛盾（Yes 与 better not）；C 是餐桌上婉拒食物的说法；D 用于回应称赞。

items.stem: Choose the best response: - Shall we meet at 7 tomorrow? - ___
options: Sorry, I'll be at work then. How about 8?
That's a good idea of you.
I don't think so, thank you.
items.analysis: Shall we ...? 用于提出建议并商定时间；A 先说明理由婉拒，再另提时间 How about 8，是地道的协商方式。B 用 shall 机械重复，不合习惯；C 搭配错误（应为 That's a good idea）；D 生硬且答非所问。

items.stem: Choose the best response: - Would you mind opening the window? - ___
items.analysis: Would you mind doing ...? 表示请求，同意帮忙时用 Of course not / Not at all（当然不介意）。B 中 Yes 表示“介意”，与 please 矛盾；C 结构错误（应为 No, I don't mind）；D 用于表示认同。

items.stem: Complete the reply politely (refuse the invitation and give a reason): - We're going hiking on Sunday. Would you like to join us? - ___
items.answer: I'd love to, but I have to look after my grandmother that day.
items.analysis: 英语中拒绝邀请的礼貌公式是：先表达意愿（I'd love to / That sounds great），再用 but 说明理由（I have to ...），必要时补一句下次的邀约。直接说 No, I can't 显得生硬，只给理由而不表达意愿也不够礼貌。

items.stem: Judge whether the statement is true or false: In English, when you refuse an invitation, it is polite to give a short reason and, if possible, suggest another time.
items.analysis: 英语交际中拒绝邀请的礼貌原则是“先致意、再说明理由、后给替代方案”，这样既表明并非不愿交往，也把选择权交回对方。只说 No 而不给理由会被视为冷淡，故该说法正确。

items.stem: You are in a shop and want to know the price of a shirt. What do you say?
items.analysis: 询问价格用 How much is ...?。How many 后接可数名词复数，问数量；What is this shirt? 问“这是什么”；Who 用于问人，三个选项都不符合“问价钱”的交际目的。

items.stem: A stranger says: Excuse me, could you tell me the way to the station? You don't know the way. What do you say?
options: Sorry, I'm a stranger here myself.
items.analysis: 无法提供帮助时应先致歉再说明原因，Sorry, I'm a stranger here myself（抱歉，我也是外地人）得体且信息明确。You're welcome 用于回应感谢；Yes, please 用于接受提议；That's all right 用于回应道歉或感谢。

items.stem: At a dinner table, your host offers you more food but you are already full. What is the most polite reply?
options: No, thanks. It was delicious, but I'm really full.
items.analysis: 婉拒食物要先致谢、再称赞、后说明原因，B 三层俱全，最得体。A 生硬；C 极不礼貌，等于否定主人的款待；D 语气像命令，不符合客人的身份。

items.stem: You are late for a class and want to enter the classroom. What is the most appropriate thing to say to the teacher?
options: I'm sorry I'm late. May I come in?
Why did you start without me?
items.analysis: 迟到进教室应先道歉再请求许可（May I come in?），语气恭敬。B 是命令句；C 反过来责怪老师；D 推卸责任，三者都违背课堂交际的礼貌原则。

items.stem: The phone rings and you answer it. Which is the most appropriate?
options: I am Li Ming, what do you want?
Hello, this is Li Ming speaking.
items.analysis: 接电话时自报身份用 This is ... speaking，简洁礼貌。B 直接问对方身份过于唐突（应说 May I know who is calling?）；C 的 what do you want 带有不耐烦；D 催促对方，极不礼貌。

items.stem: You disagree with a colleague at a formal meeting. Write one polite sentence to express your different view (no more than 15 words).
items.answer: I'm afraid I see it differently. Could I explain my reason?
items.analysis: 正式场合表达异议要用缓冲语：I'm afraid、I see your point, but、With respect 等，先承认对方再提出不同看法，并可请求补充说明的机会。直接说 You are wrong 会伤及对方面子，不符合会议的礼貌规范。

items.stem: Judge whether the statement is true or false: When you answer a phone call at the office, saying Who are you? is as polite as saying May I know who is calling?
items.analysis: Who are you? 语气生硬，带有质问意味；May I know who is calling? 用 May I 委婉询问，是办公电话的标准说法，两者礼貌程度并不相同，故该说法错误。
